reason: Existing documented opt-in full Events trace conflicts with mandatory all-sinks privacy in migration specification section 6. Changing or exempting it requires an explicit contract decision.

conflicting_contracts.behavior: Preserves exact outbound event JSON, private conversation text and IDs, and bounded receiver response body with credential redaction.
Private rotating diagnostic log containing full MCP Event bodies.
Logs/spans permit safe bounded fields/random correlation IDs only; texts/quotes/sessions/raw upstream causes forbidden; sentinel absent from sinks.

proposed_resolution: Keep event_trace_file configuration and private rotation lifecycle, replace raw payload/response content and native IDs with safe bounded diagnostic fields and random correlation IDs; update existing logging contract and tests before implementation. Preserve callback payload, ledger and retry behavior.
alternative: Explicitly exempt the existing opt-in private full-trace sink from section 6, retain its contract, and record that all-sinks privacy acceptance is limited.
independent_fixes: Neutral validation of malformed OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES before SDK initialization.
Restore one final MCP audit covering preflight and post-execution failures with bounded error codes.
decision: Update logging contract in T08: retain event_trace_file opt-in/rotation; safe bounded fields/random correlation IDs only; remove full-trace path without bypass. No Events wire changes and no section 6 exemption.
